mapper.sql: c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.body, c.created_at, u.handle AS author_handle, u.display_name AS author_display_name, u.avatar_key AS author_avatar_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments (post_id, user_id, body) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{body})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT post_id AS postId, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments WHERE post_id IN #{id} GROUP BY post_id
